versions.changelog:
- Added license information (MIT) and clarified the unofficial, oapi-codegen-based nature of the Go clients.
- Expanded documentation to explain how to find endpoints and types using go doc and pkg.go.dev.
- Improved sections on method naming, usage, and endpoint lookup for both Platform and Partition APIs.
- Removed redundant environment variable requirement for `UNSTRUCTURED_API_KEY` and updated metadata.
- Deleted the sample file skill-card.md.

Initial release of go-unstructured skill.

- Provides typed Go clients for the Unstructured Platform and Partition APIs.
- Supports sources, destinations, workflows, jobs, templates, notifications, usage (platform), and multipart document extraction (partition).
- Guides safe API key usage and secure connection practices.
- Only invokes on Go projects needing Unstructured API operations or already importing github.com/psyb0t/go-unstructured.
- Includes permissions to edit Go source, install dependencies, and securely send API calls over HTTPS.
- Usage instructions and safety recommendations included in documentation.
